Statistically significant associations following BH multiple hypothesis testing are asterisked (** p < 0.05; *p<0.1) index <- c("Stage", "Grade", "pT", "pN", "pM", "LN.Ratio", "Age.at.op", "Follow.up.Survival..months.", "Gender.Male.1..F.0", "Location") Stemp <- S2[, index] Stemp$Grade[which(Stemp$Grade == "Mucinous")] <- NA DFmat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(index), ncol = length(index)) colnames(DFmat) <- index rownames(DFmat) <- index DFmatp <- DFmat for (i in 1:length(index)) { for (j in 1:length(index)) { a1 <- cor.test(as.numeric(Stemp[, i]), as.numeric(Stemp[, j]), method = "kendall", use = "complete") DFmat[i, j] <- a1$statistic DFmatp[i, j] <- a1$p.value } } diag(DFmatp) <- 1 DFmatp2 <- matrix(p.adjust(DFmatp), nrow = length(index)) / 2 dfnew <- melt(DFmat) dfm2 <- melt(DFmatp2) dfnew$p <- dfm2$value dfnew$sig <- ifelse(dfnew$p < 0.1, "*", ifelse(dfnew$p < 0.05, "**", "")) ggplot(data = dfnew, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) + geom_tile() + scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2C7BB6", mid = "white", high = "#D7191C") + geom_text(aes(label = sig), color = "black", size = 5) + labs(y = NULL, x = NULL, fill = "tau") + theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0)) 4.4 Univariate clinicopathological association with survival status (Fig1B) Perform a univariate cox regression model for survival status for the above variables, and list in a forest plot.
